visualizationDefinition: Displays a weighted directed graph and highlights the minimum S-T cut: S-side nodes are colored and cut edges (directed from S to T) are colored and dashed.

solver.solverDefinition: Uses the Edmonds-Karp algorithm (BFS-based Ford-Fulkerson max-flow) to find the maximum s-t flow, then identifies the minimum cut S side via BFS on the residual graph from the source. Certificate format: {node1,node2,...} representing the S side of the minimum cut.
